headline.rule: a country is scored if IEA PAMS is observed for at least one of its cells (over the headline technologies in `techs`); a component it lacks everywhere is left out and policy_basis records what its index rests on (e.g. 'IEA PAMS only'; user decision 9 Oct 2026, both were required before); weights are renormalised over the components present in each cell

pams_only.label: IEA PAMS alone for every country (CAT dropped)

intro_scurve_weights_median_spearman.tbd: median Spearman correlation of ES and EO ranks with the baseline across S-curve curvatures and category-weight perturbations
intro_scurve_weights_median_spearman.fill: closely (median within-pair Spearman correlations, over rankable cells, between 0.964 and 0.997 for $\ES$ and between 0.965 and 0.992 for $\EO$, the lowest at $\gamma=2$)

intro_si_sign_spearman.tbd: rank correlation between SI with security need $1-\ES$ and SI with security $\ES$
intro_si_sign_spearman.fill: 0.33 (Spearman, pooled over the 3{,}154 cells of the 174 countries with a Strategic Index; the median within-country correlation is 0.32), and the allied pick survives the change of sign for only 5 of the 57 coalition members

strategic_all_ranked.tbd: rank correlation and top-sector agreement between the baseline and the all-ranked variant
strategic_all_ranked.fill: a Spearman correlation of 0.86 between the baseline and the all-ranked variant (pooled; median within country 0.85) and the same allied pick for 20 of the 57 coalition members

strategic_top_sector_agreement.tbd: top-sector agreement under the opposite security orientation, without the sector priors, and with all terms ranked within country
strategic_top_sector_agreement.fill: that the allied pick is unchanged for 5 of the 57 coalition members under the opposite security orientation, for 31 without the sector priors and for 20 with all terms ranked within country

appendix_d_nipo.tbd: sensitivity of the Policy index, the SI and the allied selection to dropping the NIPO component, or to rescoring it on the July 2026 extract if that run is made
appendix_d_nipo.fill: the effect of adding the October 2026 NIPO component (GTA NIPO as of 5 October 2026, 77 jurisdictions) back to the Policy index with its former weight (NIPO 4, IEA PAMS 3, CAT 2), IEA PAMS still required, which the final composite excludes: NIPO is observed for 77 policy-eligible jurisdictions and in 27 per cent of the Strategic Index cells; for those jurisdictions the within-country Spearman correlation between the policy ranks with and without it has a median of 0.88 (range 0.00 to 1.00), and the allied pick is unchanged for 34 of the 57 coalition members (27 of the 50 members with a NIPO score)

strategic_margins.tbd: Number of members whose margin between the first and second sector is below 0.01, and the members with no selection
strategic_margins.fill: The margin between a member's first and second eligible sectors is below 0.005 for 10 of the 57 members, below 0.01 for 21 and below 0.02 for 37 (median 0.015); every member has a selection

policy_basis_spearman.tbd: within-country agreement of the policy ranking on IEA PAMS alone and on the composite
policy_basis_spearman.fill: for the 65 countries scored on both components, the within-country Spearman correlation between the policy values on IEA PAMS alone and on the composite has a median of 0.48 (interquartile range 0.41 to 0.57)

normalization_category_sets.tbd: share of ES and EO technology-stage pairs in which all scored countries share one category set, and the distribution of the number of observed categories per cell
normalization_category_sets.fill: all scored economies share one category set in 30 of the 30 headline $\ES$ pairs and in 33 of the 33 $\EO$ pairs, and the median scored cell observes 3 of the ten categories in $\ES$ and 6 in $\EO$
